session_command: target/release/litex -compact -session -before examples/05_compiler_interop/compile_to_lean_well_defined_object_dag.lit (standalone examples have no litex.config, so startup is expected to reject); isolated release runner used for the source gate
proof_spine: Freeze one WellDefinedObjId for each environment-owned successful WD cache entry
Retain ordered child uses with FunctionArgument layer and argument positions
Freeze one source-occurrence-to-WellDefinedObjId edge for every source application and proof-carrying descendant
On a parent cache hit, project newly parsed descendant occurrences onto the cached child IDs through typed positions
Emit scoped child obj_N declarations before the parent and reuse one obj_N on cache hits
Freeze each proper layered-call prefix through a FunctionPrefix edge and obj_N_result
Replay application return membership through Litex.fnSetResult and exact FactId/WellDefinedFactId evidence

blocks.intent: Compile f(g(a), t(b)) with named child and parent WD objects

attempts.candidate:
forall a, b R, g fn(x R) R, t fn(x R) R, f fn(x, y R) R:
    f(g(a), t(b)) = f(g(a), t(b))
attempts.verifier_evidence: the release runner accepts the source; focused tests retain two ordered direct child IDs, two distinct source-use edges per repeated expression, and one reused outer ID; deleting, duplicating, or retargeting an occurrence edge fails closed; generated Lean compiles against Mathlib
attempts.diagnosis: the former certificate collapsed construction positions into an unordered/deduplicated child-ID list and the emitter had no stable object declarations
attempts.next_change: keep cache identity, construction roles, proposition facts, and Lean scope application as distinct compiler records

blocks.accepted_litex:
forall a, b R, g fn(x R) R, t fn(x R) R, f fn(x, y R) R:
    f(g(a), t(b)) = f(g(a), t(b))
blocks.reusable_lesson: A WD cache hit is an object-identity citation, not permission to rebuild the object or search for equivalent membership propositions. If the hit skips recursive verification, the cached typed child recipe is the only valid way to map new nested source occurrences.
